newsitem.title: ISRAEL: UBS seeks Tel Aviv bourse membership.
newsitem.headline: UBS seeks Tel Aviv bourse membership.

text.p: Union Bank of Switzerland has filed a request to become a member of the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange, according to a statement from the bourse released on Tuesday.

Currently there are no foreign members on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange. The request was filed by UBS Israel Securities Ltd, which is 50 percent owned by UBS UK Holding Ltd and 50 percent by UBS UK Finance Ltd.
The companies are subsidiaries of Union Bank of Switzerland in Zurich.
The bourse has requested that any of its members possessing information which could aid it in reaching a decision should submit such information by August 20.
UBS is among the largest foreign players in Israel.
The bourse was closed on Tuesday in honour of the Jewish fast day of Tisha B'Av and officials there were not available for comment.
UBS representative in Israel Daniel Carasso and UBS officials in London could not immediately be reached for comment.
